name: Infobip

sources.quote: Sign up using the online form. You do not need to provide payment details.
The sender's name must be linked to the company or individual and should match the initials from the person's ID card. If it doesn't, a trademark certificate is required.
To create and manage a WABA, businesses must have a Meta business portfolio

open_questions: Infobip's sign-up is an online form and its service terms (https://www.infobip.com/policies/service-terms-conditions) exclude only people under legal age or barred by law, but no Infobip page says whether an individual without a registered business can send in production. Sender registration differs by country: Kenya accepts a sender name linked to 'the company or individual', Nigeria asks for a CAC certificate; WhatsApp needs a Meta business portfolio.

description: Infobip is a global cloud communications platform with country-by-country SMS coverage across Africa, plus WhatsApp, voice and email APIs and a 2FA (OTP) service. Each account has its own base URL.
example_prompt: Send an OTP by SMS to a user in Côte d'Ivoire with Infobip 2FA and verify the code they type.
